name: Reletter - AI Image Text Editor
tagline: Edit image text with OCR or AI redraw. Free previews; clean downloads use credits.
description: Reletter is an online image text editor for screenshots, menus, documents and product photos. Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP, recognize English or Simplified Chinese text, and edit each detected region independently. Standard editing runs in the browser with adjustable text, font, size, color and position. Pro AI redraw works on a selected context crop for textured backgrounds, packaging and posters, then composites the result into the original image. Editing and watermarked previews are free. A clean Standard download costs 5 credits per result; each Pro generation costs 10 credits including result download. One-time credit packs cost $4.99 for 100 credits, $19.99 for 650 and $49.99 for 1900. No subscription. OCR, font matching and AI lettering can be imperfect; review results before downloading.
